communityDraft: Start by counting actual document pages rather than the numbers printed in the footer. A folded duplex sheet holds four book pages, so a booklet may need up to three padding pages. Check whether the blank appears in the imposed preview. Then make a tiny numbered proof and verify the printer's front/back orientation before printing the whole book. Do not send a private manuscript to a stranger to diagnose the problem.
afkDraft: Model Scout estimates whether model weights and KV cache could fit the stated budget. It does not prove that Ollama supports that artifact, has loaded it, or can answer. Use the application's preparation checks, then verify a real chat response. If a prerequisite is unavailable, follow the setup/recovery action shown by the application. Avoid deleting models, stopping unrelated containers or treating a hardware estimate as Ready. AFK's existing MIT-licensed core remains free; any future paid support or deployment service requires a separate owner decision.
